messages:
linda: Opening a thread  noticed saved-query preview is misleading when route-level routing policies include conditional fallbacks (quota- and health-based). Saved view pinned to redwood/galaxy-v2 but preview assumes 100% galaxy-v2 cost. QA shows many requests actually fall back to galaxy-v2-quant or regional variants.

omar: Do we have separate telemetry fields for requested vs served model or are we conflating them? If conflated we can't show observed mix reliably.

trent: We already capture requested_model and served_model in raw logs, but console's summaries coalesce them into a single model label during rollup. That was done to reduce cardinality.

linda: That's the root cause. UX idea: when a savedview includes a pinned model we should show a compact "expected/observed mix" panel with two lines: "Simulated (policy): ..." and "Observed (7d rollup): ...". Show a confidence pill for observed.

omar: Backend sketch: extend GET /v1/savedviews/{id}/preview?mode=config|observed to return optional fields: mix_sim and mix_observed (stringified arrays). Keep fields optional to avoid migration pain.

trent: Concern: storing snapshots per savedview could bloat indexes. Prefer compute-on-preview with caching. For config mode, run a routing simulator that expands policy (weights + quota gates + region availability) deterministically. For observed, query served_model rollups (hourly aggregates) and compute percentages.

ux-bot: Microcopy suggestion from UX: Header: "Estimated token cost" with a mode toggle "[Config simulation] [Observed (last 7d)]". For observed mode include tooltip: "Confidence: High/Medium/Low based on N requests".

telemetry-bot: telemetry: emitted served_model.rollup for route:team-frontend at 1866999900 (counts: galaxy-v2=7200, galaxy-v2-quant=800, galaxy-regional=0).

omar: Pricing: ensure pricing-service exposes quantized variant prices; if missing, preview should show "price unknown" and render total as range. Emit event savedview_preview_missing_pricing when that happens.

trent: Caching: cache preview per savedview+mode for 120s to 300s. Add preview_generated_at timestamp in response so UI can indicate staleness.

linda: Telemetry events we need: savedview_preview_requested {mode, savedview_id}, savedview_preview_mode_toggled, savedview_preview_mismatch (observed != pinned). Also log sample_size for observed.

ux-bot: Behavior for canaries: default to config simulation; add a small link "Why does observed differ?" that opens the routing policy timeline explaining quota hits or region health events.

omar: API prototype (minimal): {"preview_generated_at":"1867001200","mix_sim":"galaxy-v2:85%, galaxy-v2-quant:15%","mix_observed":"galaxy-v2:90%, galaxy-v2-quant:10%","total_cost":"$0.32"} 

trent: Implementation owners: omar -> API & sim service, linda -> UX mock & copy, telemetry -> add events, infra -> ensure rollup latency is acceptable.

linda: I'll schedule a 30min sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to align. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
